Name: Darker Dirt and Cliffs
Author: Nanomatic
Description:
[size=5]UPDATE VERSION 4.0: [/size]

Updated for Stardew Valley version 1.5.6, now working with Ginger Island!

This mod is for Content Patcher, just have it load last to cover all the dirt! It should also now be mostly update proof, but let me know if you find something that doesn't look right.

[size=4]Dark and Light versions available![/size]

Other things:

-Darkened the canyon under the quarry bridge
-Darkened worms so they are easier to see
-Darkened the rock by the mine to blend better
-Fixed a part under the quarry bridge that was messed up in fall
-Darkened fertilizer

Description:

I have never been a huge fan of the yellow dirt in Stardew Valley, so I decided to make the dirt a nice medium brown, and make the cliffs rich and dark. I also wanted watered dirt to stand out more, so it would be easier to see underneath plants, and look more like actual watered soil. Railroads and mine tracks are also darker.

Only install either the light or the dark version!
